name: Application-specific left menu & chapter lifecycle
description: Freezes the host shell behaviour where the active app injects its own nested navigation into the left side panel (Atlassian/Sentry convention), replacing top navigation tabs, and the Add/Edit/View/Delete chapter lifecycle plus org-context app gating (disabled state) rendered inside it. Approving these frames approves that shell-injection model.

frames.title: Application-Specific Left Menu (Atlassian/Sentry convention) & Chapter Lifecycle
frames.summary: Active app's nested menu items injected into the host left-side panel underneath the active app, replacing the top navigation tabs, with the Add/Edit/View/Delete chapter lifecycle and an org-context-gated (disabled) menu item.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Shows active app nested menu items injected into the host left-side panel underneath the active app, replaces top navigation tabs with sidebar items, demonstrates Add/Edit/View/Delete chapter lifecycle actions, and demonstrates org-context app gating (disabled state).
